questions.question: If the selling price of an article is 3/4 times its cost price, the profit/loss percent is:
questions.solution:
Let the cost price of the article be Rs. 4

Hence, SP of the article = 4 × (3/4) = Rs. 3

Now, Loss = 4 – 3 = 1

∴ Loss percentage = (1/4) × 100 = 25%

questions.question: A rectangular paper of width 7 cm is rolled along its length and a cylinder of radius 9 cm is formed. The volume of the cylinder is:(Take π = 22/7)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The radius of the cylinder r = 9 cm

Height of the cylinder h = 7 cm [width of the paper]

**Formulae used:**

Volume of the cylinder = πr2h

**Calculation:**

As we know,

Volume of the cylinder = πr²h = 22/7 × 9 × 9 × 7 = 1782 cm²

questions.question: If the difference between the simple and compound interests on a sum of money for 2 years at 5% p.a. is Rs. 125, the sum (in Rs.) is:
questions.solution:
As we know,

Percentage Difference in two years of CI and SI = P(r/100)² %

⇒ 125 = (P × 5 × 5)/(100 × 100)

⇒ P = (125 × 100 × 100)/(5 × 5)

∴ P = 50000

questions.question: The radii of two cylinders A and B are in the ratio of 5 : 6 and the heights are in the ratio of 7 : 4 respectively. The ratio of curved surface area of cylinder B to that of A is:
questions.solution:
As we know,

Curved surface area of cylinder = 2πrh

The ratio of radius of two cylinder A and B (r₁ : r₂) = 5 : 6

The ratio of height of two cylinder A and B (h₁ : h₂) = 7 : 4

∴ The ratio of curved surface area of cylinder B and A = (2πr₂h₂) : (2πr₁h₁) = (6 × 4) : (5 × 7) = 24 : 35

questions.question: A shopkeeper purchased 120 pears for Rs. 15 each. However, 10 pears were rotten and thrown away. The remaining sold at Rs. 18 each. What will be the percentage profit?
questions.solution:
Cost of 1 pear = Rs. 15

Cost of 120 pears = 120 × 15 = Rs. 1800

SP of 1 pear = Rs. 18

SP of 120 pears = 110 × 18 = Rs. 1980

Hence, Profit = 1980 – 1800 = 180

∴ Profit percentage = (180/1800) × 100 = 10%

questions.question: If LCM of two numbers 390 and 420 is 5460, then the HCF of two numbers is:
questions.solution:
As we know

Multiplication of two numbers = HCF × LCM

⇒ HCF × 5460 = 390 × 420

⇒ HCF = (390 × 420)/5460

⇒ HCF = 30

questions.question: In a school there are 550 students. The ratio of the boys to that of the girls is 6 : 5. How many more girls should join the school so that the ratio becomes 5 : 6?
questions.solution:
Total number of students in the school = 550

Number of girls in the school = 550 × (5/11) = 250

Number of boys in the school = 550 – 250 = 300

Let the x girls join the school.

300/(250 + x) = 5/6

⇒ 6/5 × 300 = 250 + x

⇒ x = 360 – 250

∴ x = 110

questions.question: At the rate of 8% the amount invested earns a simple interest of Rs. 240 after 3 years. If the rate of interest been 5% more, then how much more interest would it have earned?
questions.solution:
**Short Trick:**

SI on rate 8% = Rs. 240

SI on Rate 5% = [240/8] × 5 = Rs. 150

**Detailed Method:**

SI = 240, r = 8% and time = 3 years

As we know,

SI = P × r × t/100

⇒ 240 = (P × 8 × 3)/100

⇒ P = (240 × 100)/24

⇒ P = 1000

Again,

New rate = 8% + 5% = 13%

P = 1000, and time = 3 years

SI = (1000 × 13 × 3)/100

⇒ SI = 390

∴ The interest more than that of before = 390 – 240 = 150.

questions.question: Two pipes P and Q can fill an empty tank in 20 min and 10 min respectively. R can empty a full tank in 15 minutes. If all three pipes are opened together, how much time (in minutes) will they take to fill the tank?
questions.solution:
Let capacity of tank = LCM of (20, 10 and 15) = 60 units

Hence, efficiency of P = 60/20 = 3 units/min

Efficiency of Q = 60/10 = 6 units/min

Efficiency of R = - 60/15 = - 4 units/min

Now, combined efficiency = 3 + 6 – 4 = 5 units/min

∴ Time taken = 60/5 = 12 minutes

questions.question: The average weight of 38 students is 42 kg. It was found later that the figure of 46 kg was misread as 26 kg in one of the readings. What is the correct average? (correct to one decimal places)
questions.solution:
Average weight of 38 students is = 42 kg

Sum of weight of 38 students = 42 × 38 = 1596

Correct sum of weight of 38 students = 1596 – 26 + 46 = 1616

Correct average of 38 students = 1616/38 = 42.5

**Short trick:**

Correct average of 38 students = 42 + (46 – 26)/38 = 42 + 20/38 = 42 + 0.52 ≈ 42.5

questions.question: In an examination, there are 800 boys and 600 girls. 40% boys and 60% girls passed the examination. The percentage (correct to two decimal places) of failed students from the total students is:
questions.solution:
Number of boys = 800

Number of girls = 600

Hence, total students = 800 + 600 = 1400

Number of boys who failed = 800 × (60/100) = 480

Number of girls who failed = 600 × (40/100) = 240

Hence, total failed students = 480 + 240 = 720

∴ The percentage of failed students = (720/1400) × 100 = 51.43%

questions.question: The diagonal of a square is equal to the side of an equilateral triangle. If the area of the square is 18√3 sq. cm. What is the area (in cm²) of the equilateral triangle?
questions.solution:
As we know,

Area of the equilateral triangle = [√3/4] a²

Diagonal of a square = √2 a

Area of the square = a²

a² = 18√3

⇒ a = √[18 √3]

Diagonal of a square = √2a

Diagonal of the square = √2 × √[18 √3] 

Side of the equilateral triangle = √2 × √[18 √3] [Diagonal of the square]

Area of the equilateral triangle = [√3/4] [√2 × √(18 √3)]² = [√3/4] × 2 × (18 √3) = 27

questions.question: If a student walks with speed 30% more than the usual speed, he reaches 15 min earlier to his destination. How much time (in minutes) does he take to reach his destination normally?
questions.solution:
30% = 3/10

Let the normal speed of the student be 10x

Hence, increased speed of the students = 10x × (13/10) = 13x

Ratio of speed of student normally to increased = 10x : 13x

Hence, time ratio taken by student normally to after = 13x : 10x

As we know, Time is inversely proportional to speed.

13x – 10x = 15 min

⇒ 3x = 15

⇒ x = 15/3 = 5 min

∴ Normal time = 13 × 5 = 65 min

questions.question: The average of 21 data is 36, out of which the first 12 data are having an average of 15. The average of the rest 9 data is:
questions.solution:
Average data of 21 is = 36

Hence, sum of data = 36 × 21 = 756

Average of first 12 data = 15

Hence, sum of first 12 data = 12 × 15 = 180

Now, sum of last 9 data = 756 – 180 = 576

∴ Average of last 9 data = 576/9 = 64
